phase_D_return.poll: read-only Poi mission_status polling every 25 s
phase_D_return.reason: Poi's mission_status only advances when the client emits api_port/port; a fleet that is out produces no such response while the client sits on the home port
phase_D_return.detection: visible UI refresh navigation (3 clicks, 6 samples per step) then mission=[2,1,1793897769682,0]

phase_E_settlement.attribution_rule: R3-F: the fleet's ship-ID set plus 'no other fleet has an unaccepted result'; asserted before any click
phase_E_settlement.why_not_settle_visible_reward_chain: that entry attributes the fleet through the durable dispatch record written by ContinuousDispatchController; this dispatch came from live_dispatch_expedition.py, which writes no such record, so the controller would refuse rather than accept a fabricated record. The three production atomic steps were driven directly instead.

phase_F_reconciliation.closure_self_consistency: the fleet ends at fuel 11/15 per ship, exactly the state observed before resupply, so resupply -> dispatch -> consumption -> return -> settlement returns the fleet to its recurring 'needs resupply' state

click_audit.counting_rule: only events that actually sent a click; preset *_verified values and summary *_completed values are never counted
